Metro Housing | Boston

Get housing help, starting today.

Whether you need help with rent, a place to live, or you're worried about losing your home, our team is ready to walk you through your options.

Call (617) 859-0400 See how we can help

What is HCEC?

The Housing Consumer Education Center (HCEC) is Metro Housing|Boston’s front door for housing help — a free resource for anyone with a housing question or crisis, wherever they are in their journey.

Housing information and support

A place to start, with real answers to your housing questions.

Help understanding your options

We help you make sense of the resources available to you.

Information, referrals, and case management

From your first call onward, a specialist can help guide your case.

Connections to the right resources

We connect you to appropriate housing and financial assistance programs.

Our services

HCEC is Metro Housing|Boston's front door for housing help, offering a full range of free services — from emergency financial assistance to hands-on case management — to help residents find and keep stable housing.

Residential Assistance

Help accessing emergency financial assistance such as RAFT, which can provide funding to help households stay housed or move through a housing crisis.

Learn more →

Housing Search

One-on-one support navigating the housing search — including help obtaining the forms and documents needed to apply for housing.

Learn more →

Information, Referral & Case Management

Connections to financial assistance, legal aid, move-in help, budgeting and utility support — paired with ongoing case management.

Learn more →

Colocations

HCEC case management delivered at convenient, community-based partner locations across the Greater Boston area we serve.

Learn more →

Workshops

Free educational workshops covering eviction prevention, housing search strategies, affordable housing basics and tenant rights.

Learn more →

Other Resources

Free access to fact sheets, newsletters and reference materials, plus internet and phone access to support your housing search.

Learn more →

Need to speak with someone?

Walk in Mondays from 9:00 AM until capacity is reached — no appointment needed. Can't make it in? Call or email us to schedule a time.

Housing help in your community

HCEC's work doesn't stop at our front door. Through colocation partnerships and a service area that spans Greater Boston, help is often closer than you'd expect.

Boston, by neighborhood population

What are colocations?

HCEC doesn't only operate from Metro Housing's central Roxbury office. Through colocations, HCEC partners with community organizations across Greater Boston to place housing counselors directly at neighborhood-based sites.

Why they exist

Colocations bring services to where people already are, so residents don't have to travel to get help. Each site is shaped around that neighborhood's needs — working alongside, not duplicating, the local resources already there.

How to access support

Support at a colocation site is arranged through the partner organization hosting it. You can also always reach HCEC directly: walk in Mondays from 9:00 AM until capacity is reached, or call the Resource Line to schedule a time.

Frequently asked questions

Who can use HCEC?

HCEC is a free resource for anyone with a housing question or crisis, wherever they are in their housing journey.

Is HCEC free?

Yes. HCEC is a free service — there's no cost to get help with housing questions, applications, or a housing crisis.

Do I need an appointment?

No. You can walk in Mondays from 9:00 AM until capacity is reached. If Monday doesn't work for you, call or email the Resource Line to schedule a time.

How can I contact HCEC?

Call the Resource Line at 617-425-6700 or email ResourceLine@MetroHousingBoston.org. You can also walk in Mondays from 9:00 AM until capacity is reached.

What kind of help does HCEC provide?

HCEC offers Residential Assistance, Housing Search help, Information & Referral with case management, Colocations at community sites, Workshops, and other housing resources.

Where are HCEC services available?

HCEC's main office is in Boston, and through colocation partnerships, HCEC staff are also placed at community sites across Greater Boston — bringing services closer to where residents live.

Can HCEC help me with housing search?

Yes. Housing Search is one of HCEC's core services, helping residents find and pursue housing options.

Can HCEC help with RAFT?

Yes. HCEC can help with RAFT applications, application status, Letters of Intent, payment inquiries, and the landlord/tenant RAFT portal.
